label: Blender
description: Control Blender 5.1+ for 3D modeling and export to UEFN via the official Blender MCP add-on. The add-on is installed into Blender automatically — open Blender after enabling.

settings.sections.title: Connection
settings.sections.description: On enable, this plugin copies the official Blender MCP add-on (Blender 5.1+) into your Blender user extensions and a startup script that enables it. Open (or restart) Blender — the server auto-starts on the port below. Use blender_status / blender_redeploy_addon tools if needed.

properties.label: Port
properties.description: Blender MCP add-on port (default 9876, matches the add-on preference).

steps.title: Blender plugin enabled
steps.body: The official Blender MCP add-on was copied into Blender 5.1+. Restart Blender once: the startup script turns on Allow Online Access, enables the add-on, and starts its server on 9876. No uv / GitHub install, no IDE MCP config.

steps.title: Talk to Blender
steps.body: With Blender open, ask the agent to inspect the scene, find the heaviest mesh, rename datablocks, or model. Tools appear under blender_*. For text/image-to-3D generation, install the meshy or 3D AI Studio Store plugin.
